processed.capability: Hosted API hardening plus authenticated user profiles and encrypted per-user LLM provider keys
prerequisites: Install locked backend dependencies so the existing security suite can run
Validate current migrations and RLS against a disposable Supabase instance

processed.reason: Commit ba6f771 is an ancestor of current main, and ROSS has evolved its seams with stricter secret isolation, MFA, CORS/data-boundary middleware, additional providers, and revoked browser grants. Because this spans authentication, secrets, cryptography, schemas/RLS, dependencies, and privacy content, ancestry alone cannot establish production-safe equivalence. The focused security suite could not run because tsx is not installed.
processed.architecture_brief: Evaluate the existing ROSS-native implementation at backend/src/index.ts for HTTP controls, backend/src/routes/user.ts for authenticated/MFA-aware APIs, backend/src/lib/userApiKeys.ts for encrypted key handling, additive migrations plus backend/schema.sql for RLS/grants, and the existing frontend profile/API contexts. Do not replay the monolithic upstream patch.
implementation_plan: Run the locked backend security suite and add endpoint-level coverage for profile validation, MFA enforcement, provider-key precedence, and non-disclosure.
Test key encryption, rotation/failure behavior, account deletion, and tenant isolation using a disposable database.
Verify trusted-proxy rate limiting, CORS, Helmet, and hosted data-boundary behavior in a deployment-like harness.
Review schema migration ordering, RLS/grants, privacy/terms/support content, and residual differences with security, data, and legal owners.
